title: Find the Maximum Divisibility Score
summary: Given integer arrays nums and divisors, the divisibility score of a divisor is how many elements of nums it divides evenly. Return the divisor with the maximum score; ties go to the smallest divisor.
officialConstraints: 1 <= nums[i], divisors[i] <= 10^9 (the source page shows the exponent as 109; interpreted as 10^9)
visualizationNotes: Example 1 divisors are written as [5,3,7,2) on the source page; the bracket is a typo, and the source's own scores (5->2, 3->2, 7->0, 2->2) confirm [5,3,7,2]. Visualization uses the full official limits; one divisor is scored per step.
